### tool/vocabulary/corpus/b09/answers/emergency-call-taker.txt ### Call log
state query=""
state selected=""
state calls=[{"id":"24-118803","time":"14:02","type":"Medical","addr":"2214 Alder Street","priority":1,"length":412},{"id":"24-118797","time":"13:41","type":"Fire","addr":"88 Dock Road","priority":2,"length":233},{"id":"24-118790","time":"13:12","type":"Police","addr":"410 Mercer Avenue","priority":3,"length":150},{"id":"24-118784","time":"12:55","type":"Traffic","addr":"I-95 northbound, mile 14","priority":2,"length":301}]
App
  Sidebar
    Brand "Dispatch One" icon="emergency"
    NavItem "Active call" icon="call" onTap={go call}
    NavItem "Units" icon="local_shipping" onTap={go units}
    NavItem "Call log" icon="history" selected onTap={go call-log}
    Spacer grow
    Text.muted "Call taker: J. Okafor"
  Main
    Nav
      Heading "Call log" level=1
      Input "Search calls" @query w=240
    Column pad=24 gap=12
      Card gap=0
        Row pad=8 gap=8
          Text.strong "Call" w=110
          Text.strong "Time" w=70
          Text.strong "Type" w=90
          Text.strong "Address" grow
          Text.strong "Priority" w=80
          Text.strong "Length" w=80
        each c in filter(calls,x=>contains(lower(x.addr),lower(query)) || contains(lower(x.type),lower(query)))
          Row pad=8 gap=8 middle border-top=#FFE0E0E0 onTap={selected=c.id; open callDetail}
            Text.mono "{c.id}" w=110
            Text "{c.time}" w=70
            Text "{c.type}" w=90
            Text "{c.addr}" grow
            Badge.error "P{c.priority}" w=80 hidden={c.priority!=1}
            Badge.warning "P{c.priority}" w=80 hidden={c.priority!=2}
            Badge.success "P{c.priority}" w=80 hidden={c.priority!=3}
            Text "{duration(c.length)}" w=80
Drawer#callDetail "Call {selected}" right
  Text.muted "{find(calls,c=>c.id==selected).type} at {find(calls,c=>c.id==selected).addr}"
  Button.outline "Play recording" icon="play_arrow" onTap={toast "Playing recording"}
  Button.outline "Export report" icon="download" onTap={emit exportCall selected; toast "Report exported"}
  Button.ghost "Close" onTap={close}
